title: Product Photography for Charleston, SC Businesses
metaTitle: Product Photography for Charleston, SC Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product photography for Charleston makers and retailers: catalog, lifestyle and detail images for online stores, Amazon and ads. Ship products, get images.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for Charleston businesses that sell online: clean catalog images, styled lifestyle scenes and close detail shots, retouched and delivered in the sizes each channel requires. The method is simple and worth stating at the start. You ship your products to TDM's studio in Lahore, approve the shot list and art direction online, and receive the finished images digitally. There is no TDM studio in Charleston and no photographer visits your shop.

sections.heading: Why Charleston retailers need a second shop window
paragraphs: A great deal of Charleston retail starts with someone walking past. A visitor steps into a boutique on King Street, a stall in the City Market or a gallery in the French Quarter, buys something, and flies home. Whether that person ever buys again depends on the online store, and the online store depends on its pictures. A shop that looks beautiful in person and flat on a phone loses the repeat order.

The city also has makers who never had a shopfront: jewellers, candle and soap makers, specialty food producers, clothing labels and furniture and home goods workshops spread from the upper peninsula to Park Circle and Summerville. They sell through their own sites, through marketplaces and through wholesale buyers who ask for consistent product images before placing an order.

sections.heading: What a shoot delivers
paragraphs: We agree the full set list before anything is photographed, so every product leaves with the same angles and nothing is missed.
bullets: Studio catalog images on white or colored backgrounds, consistent across the whole range.
Lifestyle scenes built with props and sets that suit the product and the customer.
Macro shots of texture, stitching, finish and ingredients.
Image sets specified to meet Amazon and other marketplace requirements.
Retouching, color correction and background cleanup.
Files cropped and exported for your store, marketplaces, email and paid ads.

sections.heading: Shipping from Charleston: what to plan for
paragraphs: Because the products travel, a little planning saves a lot of trouble. Send one clean, undamaged sample of each item and each color, with any packaging you want shown. Fragile pieces such as glass, ceramics and framed work need proper packing and insurance. Perishable food is usually better represented by its sealed packaging plus styled scenes we prepare, and you should tell us about anything sensitive to heat. One-of-a-kind items, antiques and large furniture may not be sensible to ship at all, and we will say so before you spend on freight. Agree in advance whether samples are returned or kept.

The Charleston look itself needs a decision. If your brand leans on the Lowcountry, we can build sets that suggest it with honest materials: weathered wood, linen, oyster shell, greenery. We will not pass off a studio set as a real location. If you want the actual marsh or a real piazza behind the product, supply your own location photographs and we will match the studio images to them in color and light so the two sit together on a page.

presence: A member of our team is based in South Carolina, though not in Charleston, and can answer questions about preparing a shoot. Photography takes place at TDM's studio in Lahore: products are shipped there, direction is approved remotely and images are delivered online.

faqs.q: Do you have a product photography studio in Charleston?
faqs.a: No. Our studio is in Lahore. Charleston clients ship products to it, approve the shot list remotely and receive retouched images digitally. A member of our team is based in South Carolina if you want to talk it through first.

faqs.q: Can you photograph my products for Amazon and my own store at once?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan one session to produce white-background images that meet marketplace rules, plus lifestyle and detail images for your own site and ads, so the product looks the same wherever a customer finds it.

faqs.q: Is it worth shipping products abroad for photos?
faqs.a: For small, durable, repeatable products, usually yes. For unique, very fragile, perishable or bulky items it may not be, and a local photographer is the better choice. We will tell you which applies before you ship.

faqs.q: How much does product photography cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of products, the number of images per product and how much styling the scenes need. We quote after a free consultation and an agreed shot list.

faqs.q: How long until I receive the images?
faqs.a: That depends on the brief and on shipping. Dates for arrival, shooting, retouching and delivery are agreed in the plan before your products leave Charleston.
